title: Governance inventory
description: Catalog row governance-inventory 1.0.0: the model inventory of Contraste's own case models (data/derived/governance/inventory.json): one entry per fit (case_id/fit_id) with the 40 B.2 attributes, the components, the scope record, the tier block, the lifecycle state, the schedule dates, the dependency edges, the engine node and the governance findings of the inventory itself.

govAsOfBasis.description: Why the as-of date is the date it is (W15-13). Production rule: the date of the newest release heading of CHANGELOG.md when the bake runs, never earlier than a raised date. A fixture states that its date is chosen to exercise the overdue rule.

govDate.description: An ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). The dates of a governance document are deterministic: the as-of date and every raised date come from committed values (R4 of the U15 sizing); a wall-clock date never enters a document.

basis.description: The decision or finding of the record that raises it.

govGovFinding.description: A governance finding of the inventory itself (W15-3: the rubric blind spot, S3; W15-4: independence not established, S2).

code_version.description: The Contraste code version that wrote the document.

riskvalidation_version.description: The engine version that computed it.

generators.description: The writer of the document; a fixture is labelled fixture:u15-s-contracts.

ref.description: The git ref and commit the bytes were read from when the document is not on the branch the bake runs on (the C18 documents of the fixture); null otherwise.

documents_read.description: Every case document read, with the sha256 of its bytes (line endings normalised to LF) and its git ref.

govProvenance.description: Where a governance document came from: code and engine versions and the sha256 of every case document it read.

invAttr.description: A B.2 attribute: never a bare value. basis is the JSON pointer read, or the convention's or the absence's reason.

invAttributes.description: The 40 attributes of 06 B.2 (l.539-551), keyed A01 to A40.

invComplexity.description: C from the factor scores: the mean rounded half up, and the maximum. A factor with a null score is unscored, with its reason.

key.description: case_id/fit_id/model_id: model ids repeat across cases, so the key is the triple.

invConventions.description: The tables that are conventions (item 30 of the dossier UNVERIFIED list): named parameters, each labelled convention with its basis.

invEdge.description: A dependency (W15-8): a document read or a code import, with its stated source. Kept apart from the related links.

invEngineNode.description: The engine node every entry depends on (W15-8); its key is never an entry key.

variant_id.description: Null when the whole case is left out; a variant id when only that variant has no determinable fit (W15-15).

invExcluded.description: A case, or one variant of a case, left out of the inventory, with the reason (missing-data behavior).

share.description: The share of the stated balance; null where no balance exists.

invLifecycle.description: The B.4 lifecycle state; use before validation only with an exception record (type, approver, expiry).

invMap.description: The layered layout of the dependency map (the bake's networkx layout, a geometry and not a model value).

invMateriality.description: M = max(exposure band, regulatory use, decision criticality), under both readings of regulatory use.

invOverride.description: An override of the computed tier: a rationale and an approver are required, never silent (SS1/23 Principle 1.3(d)(e)).

invRelated.description: A link that is not a dependency: a page statement, a shared method, a shared source (A D4 5.1, 5.3).

invSchedule.description: The next review, full revalidation and monitoring dates from the tier and the frequency table (06 B.8).

invScope.description: The B.1 scope record: the four answers and the in-scope decision per jurisdiction profile (06 l.523-537).

invTier.description: The tier block: M, C, the factor scores with their tags, the tier, the override and the tier under the four readings.

invVariant.description: A variant document of the entry and the provenance rule that assigned it (W15-15): the fit whose sources the variant's provenance reads, or the single models document of the case. A variant whose fit cannot be determined is in excluded.
